dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Ho-ho, nothing can compare to my darling Mora, but the gemstones here are beautifully lustrous.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: The longer you spend in my company, the more astute your tastes grow, my apprentice. How very wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I, the magnanimous Lord Sangemah Bay, have decided that I will be staying here for a little longer. No need to thank me — I know you must feel honored, and that's enough for me.
